q08.

**`Driver`** — `store/driver.go`

This interface (defined at line 10) is the contract that all database backends implement. It declares methods for every domain model (Attachment, Memo, User, InstanceSetting, Inbox, Reaction, etc.) plus infrastructure methods like `GetDB()`, `Close()`, `IsInitialized()`, and `GetDatabaseSize()`.
